label: Crime Over Time
blurb: A line chart showing the total count of crime for each crime type, in all the selected areas. Data shown is from 2010-2025

label: Crime by Area
blurb: A line chart showing the count of all crime, where each line represents a selected area. Data shown is from 2010-2025

label: Crime Rate by LSOA
blurb: A bar chart showing the count of all crime, separated into different crime types. Each group of bars represents an area. From 2010-2025

label: Cumulative Crime per Type
blurb: A total count of crime in the different crime types, for all selected areas. Data is for over all time

label: Ofsted Ratings
blurb: The count of all schools in Kent that fall into each of the Ofsted categories. Takes the most recent Ofsted rating for each school

label: Ofsted Ratings Yearly
blurb: The count of all schools in Kent that fall into each of the Ofsted categories. Split up into yearly bar groupings.

label: School Gender Demographics
blurb: Displays the split of boys-only, girls-only, and mixed-gender schools across all Kent. Bars are grouped by stages in education.

label: Ofsted History
blurb: Shows a school's Ofsted performance, over time. Represents each selected school as a coloured line.

label: Flood Risks
blurb: Shows the count of houses at certain levels of risk from flooding. Selected areas show as the different groups of bars on the x-axis.

label: Flood Risks
blurb: Shows the count of houses at certain levels of risk from flooding. Each spoke on the chart represents a risk factor. The more houses that are in a certain risk factor, the further the point, on that spoke, is from the center. A polygon is drawn for each selected area.

label: History of Flood Occurrences.
blurb: Shows the count of flood occurrences, over time. Each line represents a different source of flooding.

label: Count of flood occurrences by source.
blurb: A bar chart showing the count of flood occurrences, separated by source. Each group of bars represents a different area.

label: Count of flood occurrences by cause.
blurb: A bar chart showing the count of flood occurrences, separated by cause. Each group of bars represents a different area.

label: Count of flood occurrences by type.
blurb: A spider chart showing the count of flood occurrences, separated by type. Each spoke represents a different type of flooding.
